draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 171st-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 26th of 36 at WR. He went 140th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (171st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (7th percentile). College production: 358 receiving yards in 2025, 35th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
